sentence: This project studies a threat to machine learning models that exploits unused parameters, and develops defenses against it.
This project holds a workshop on quantum sensing and quantum information science, with a focus on materials and devices, biosensing and imaging.
This project studies how the layered structure of the stomach affects how it moves, using medical imaging, computer modeling and biomechanics.
This project builds models to understand how molecules with unpaired electrons act as magnets and to design lighter organic magnets.
This project produces genome sequences of eight landraces of bread wheat and updates the reference genome sequence for wheat.
This project uses optical measurements to study electronic phases that form when atomic layers are stacked together or twisted at a small angle.
This project builds a nanoelectrode with a single plasmon nanoparticle to study how a semiconductor electrode absorbs light and stores it in chemical bonds.
This project studies how the matrix around cells changes as lungs develop, and uses it to grow lung tissue from stem cells.
This project runs a facility with centrifuges and shake tables to test reduced-scale models of soil and structures affected by earthquake, wave and wind loadings.
This project builds virtual reality simulations that closely mimic real patients, surgical tools and operating environments to help design robot-assisted surgery.
This project brings hands-on gene editing with CRISPR in fission yeast into college courses.
This project builds neural mappings that recover the phase of a wavefront from a single image.
This project holds a workshop that brings together researchers in quantum communication and classical networking to define quantum networked systems.
This project acquires a high-performance computing system with graphics processing units to serve researchers in a region.
